description.en: The name of the alert contact group.

description.zh: 要包含在报警联系人分组内的联系人ID。多个联系人ID以空格分隔。可调用SearchAlertContact接口来查询联系人ID，详情请参见[SearchAlertContact](~~130703~~)。
description.en: The IDs of contacts in the contact group. Separate multiple contact IDs with spaces. You can call the SearchAlertContact operation to query the contact IDs. For more information, see [SearchAlertContact](~~130703~~).

description.zh: 地域ID。默认情况下请填写`cn-hangzhou`。

descriptions.zh: 当前接口已不再维护，请使用新版告警管理的CreateOrUpdateContactGroup接口创建或修改告警联系人组。
descriptions.en: The current API operation is no longer maintained. Call the CreateOrUpdateContactGroup operation of the new Alert Management module to create or modify alert contact groups.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms create-alert-contact-group --contact-group-name TestGroup --contact-ids 120_230_340 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
